from pathlib import Path
import json,collections
s=Path('/home/claude/.scratch/eka-sky-performance');rom=(s/'assets/SYM.ROM').read_bytes()
results=[]
for route in ['sky','combat']:
 p=s/f'v8-current-census-{route}';x=json.loads((p/'guest-profile.json').read_text());report=json.loads((p/'report.json').read_text())
 categories=collections.Counter();top=[]
 for e in x['edges']:
  source=e['from'];last=(source&~1)+2*(e['length']-1);kind='ARM_or_unknown'
  if source&1 and e['length'] and 0x80000000<=last<0x80000000+len(rom)-1:
   offset=last-0x80000000;op=int.from_bytes(rom[offset:offset+2],'little');kind='thumb_other'
   if op&0xf000==0xd000 and ((op>>8)&15)<14:
    disp=op&255;disp=disp-256 if disp&128 else disp
    target=last+4+2*disp;kind='thumb_conditional_taken'if e['to']&~1==target else'thumb_conditional_untaken'
    if e['to']&~1==target and target<=last:kind='thumb_conditional_backedge'
   elif op&0xf800==0xe000:
    disp=op&2047;disp=disp-2048 if disp&1024 else disp
    target=last+4+2*disp;kind='thumb_direct_backedge'if target<=last else'thumb_direct_forward'
   elif op&0xf800 in (0xf800,0xe800):kind='thumb_call_suffix'
   elif op&0xf800==0xf000:kind='thumb_call_prefix'
   elif op&0xff00==0x4700:kind='thumb_bx_blx'
   elif op&0xff00==0xbd00:kind='thumb_pop_pc'
   elif op&0xfe00==0xb400:kind='thumb_push'
   elif op&0xf800 in (0x6000,0x7000,0x8000,0x9000,0xc000) or op&0xfe00 in (0x5000,0x5200,0x5400):kind='thumb_store'
   top.append(dict(e,last_pc=hex(last),opcode=hex(op),category=kind))
  elif source&1:kind='thumb_non_rom_or_zero'
  categories[kind]+=e['count']
 total=sum(categories.values())
 out={'route':route,'wasm_sha256':report['wasm_sha256'],'stride':x['stride'],'diagnostic_not_speed':True,'caveat':'Systematic edge samples are not exact per-category counts. Thumb ROM final halfword reconstructed only for bounded linear blocks. ARM and non-ROM excluded from opcode classification.','compiled_blocks':x['compiled_blocks'],'block_lengths':x['block_lengths'],'aot_events':x['aot_events'],'memory_calls':x['memory_calls'],'edge_categories':[{ 'category':k,'samples':v,'percent_samples':v/total*100}for k,v in categories.most_common()],'top_thumb_rom_edges':sorted(top,key=lambda e:-e['count'])[:40]}
 results.append(out)
 print(route,'blocks',x['compiled_blocks'],'callbacks',sum(x['memory_calls']),'categories',[(q['category'],round(q['percent_samples'],2))for q in out['edge_categories']])
(s/'v8-current-census-analysis.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
